mapper.insert: INSERT INTO inventory_delivered_reconciliation(order_id,evidence_fingerprint,recorded_by) VALUES(#{orderId},#{fingerprint},#{actor}) ON CONFLICT (order_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT evidence_fingerprint FROM inventory_delivered_reconciliation WHERE order_id=#{orderId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inventory_movements WHERE order_id=#{orderId} AND product_id=#{productId}
SELECT id FROM inventory_movements WHERE event_id=#{eventId}
SELECT movement_id FROM inventory_delivered_reconciliation_lines WHERE order_id=#{orderId} ORDER BY product_id FOR UPDATE
